Agent: Yeah, I hear you — it can really feel like everyone just wants to sell you something.

Agent: You’re right to be frustrated — it does feel like that a lot lately.

User: Fine, whatever. Just have Jay call me tomorrow. Let's see if he can actually help.
Agent: Got it, I’ll let Jay know you want a call back tomorrow on this number and that you’re looking to see if he can actually help. There’s no exact time locked in, so he’ll reach out as his schedule allows. Before I let you go, is there anything specific you want him to be ready to talk about, like missed calls, lead follow-up, or something else?
